name: Title card
description: A big editorial statement on the brand's paper: an eyebrow, a headline with accent words in the brand colour, and a supporting line. A carousel cover or a single hook post. Ported from the automatos-social title family.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short label in the dark pill above the headline, e.g. AI ARCHITECTURE 2026. Leave empty for none.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The big statement. Use | to break the line, e.g. AGENT|HARNESS.|THE OS|FOR AI.

headline_accent.label: Accent words
headline_accent.description: Words of the headline shown in the brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

subline.label: Supporting line
subline.description: One or two sentences under the headline. Leave empty for none.

counter.label: Page counter
counter.description: For a post in a series, e.g. 01 / 10. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The account handle shown top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: The footer's call to action, e.g. Swipe to start. Leave empty for none.

sample_data.headline: AGENT|HARNESS.|THE OS|FOR AI.
sample_data.subline: The model is the brain. The harness is everything else, and it is the piece of your AI system that decides how well it works.

probe.what: the brand stripe along the top edge
